title: ABT — Metro zone boarding and alighting
preface:
This test is to confirm ABT boarding within a Metro ABT zone (Tap On Only – Flat Fare); the customer taps once to board and the ETM calculates the alighting stop — there is no customer alighting tap on this device (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21).

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
preconds:
**GIVEN** ABT is enabled in a Metro ABT zone (route ABT Type = "Tap On Only (Flat Fare)") and a Driver is signed on to Metro route 10A
**AND** a seeded contactless card is available

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer taps once for boarding on the current Metro route
steps.expected:
**THEN** the Metro ABT zone records the boarding tap
**AND** the alighting stop is ETM-calculated as the last stop on the route within the configured Metro Network Zone (no customer alighting tap)

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** the tap is recorded with the boarding stop
**AND** it is recorded with the ETM-calculated alighting stop
Data variations: Metro mode.

citations: FBD-100658 (Alighting-location calculation — Metro ETM: last stop on the route within the configured Metro Network Zone; no driver selection on flat-fare devices)
FBD-100662 (migration plan — Metro routes set route ABT Type "Tap On Only (Flat Fare)")
George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — no customer tap-off on Metro/Ulsterbus tap-on-only ETMs; alighting is always ETM-calculated or driver-selected, never a customer tap-off action
change_note: Removed the customer 'alighting-only tap' / 'boarding-and-alighting tap' actions — these implied a customer tap-off that does not exist on this tap-on-only ETM. Reworded to a single customer boarding tap with the alighting stop ETM-calculated as the last stop in the Metro Network Zone (FBD-100658), matching the FBD-100662 Metro 'Tap On Only (Flat Fare)' route configuration. Removed the in-suite UNCONFIRMED marker (audit 2026-07-17, gap Q7) now that George has confirmed the mechanic live — closes gap-register Q7.

title: ABT — Ulsterbus zone boarding and alighting
preface:
This test is to confirm ABT boarding and driver-selected alighting within Ulsterbus ABT zones (Tap On Only – Driver Initiated); the customer taps once to board and states their alighting stage, and the Driver selects it on the FLU screen — there is no customer alighting tap on this device (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21).

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
preconds:
**GIVEN** ABT is enabled in an Ulsterbus ABT zone (route ABT Type = "Tap On Only (Driver Initiated)") and a Driver is signed on to Ulsterbus route 72b (IN)
**AND** a seeded contactless card is available

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer taps once for boarding, states their alighting stage, and the Driver selects that alighting stage on the FLU screen
steps.expected:
**THEN** the Ulsterbus ABT zone records the boarding tap
**AND** it records the driver-selected alighting stage (not ETM-calculated)

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** the tap is recorded with the boarding stop
**AND** it is recorded with the driver-selected alighting stage
Data variations: Ulsterbus mode.

citations: FBD-100662 (UX flow — driver-initiated FLU screen; customer states alighting stage, Driver selects it; "alighting location = the driver-selected stage (not ETM-calculated)")
FBD-100658 (Alighting-location calculation — Ulsterbus ETM: driver does choose alighting stage, audited directly)
George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — no customer tap-off on Metro/Ulsterbus tap-on-only ETMs; alighting is always ETM-calculated or driver-selected, never a customer tap-off action
change_note: Removed the customer 'alighting-only tap' / 'boarding-and-alighting tap' actions — these implied a customer tap-off that does not exist on this tap-on-only ETM. Reworded to a single customer boarding tap plus a driver-selected alighting stage on the FLU screen (FBD-100662 UX flow), which is the correct TOO mechanic already used for this route type elsewhere in the suite (FLU/basket driver-selects-alighting-stage wording). Removed the in-suite UNCONFIRMED marker (audit 2026-07-17, gap Q7) now that George has confirmed the mechanic live — closes gap-register Q7.

title: ZZ_DELETE_REVIEW - ABT — reverts to standard fixed fare on rule change
citations: FBD-100662 (Scope — "Supersedes the old Metro flat-fare rule for Ulsterbus routes... now Ulsterbus routes use the driver-selected-alighting TOO business rules (Metro routes keep flat fare)")
George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — flat-fare/fixed-fare behaviour is Metro-only now; an Ulsterbus 'reverts to fixed fare' claim is stale
change_note: CONDEMNED (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21): C4100588 as written asserts a Ulsterbus ABT journey 'reverts to the standard fixed fare' when a different service/journey/rule is triggered — confirmed stale. Flat-fare behaviour is Metro-only now (FBD-100662); Ulsterbus routes use the driver-selected-alighting TOO business rules instead of a fixed fare, so there is no 'fixed fare' for a UB journey to revert to. No FBD describes an equivalent UB behaviour on a mid-journey service/rule-change trigger for driver-initiated TOO, so rewording to a plausible replacement would be inventing behaviour, not correcting it (CLAUDE.md hard rule: never invent device behaviour). Condemned rather than guessing at what Ulsterbus actually does instead. Was previously stamped UNCONFIRMED in-suite (audit 2026-07-17) pointing at gap-register Q19; Q19 is now ANSWERED by George, closing the loop.
